The Mindset Graph™ captures those shifts in real time, revealing when someone is ready to engage, respond, or act. {Dynamic Mindset} The Same Person, Different Moments From morning to night, behavior shifts constantly – shaping how people engage, what they notice, and what they’re open to. {High Receptivity} Leaning in Focused and engaged, actively exploring content. More likely to notice, process, and respond to relevant messaging. {Low Receptivity} Distracted Attention is fragmented, behavior is passive. Content is skimmed, not absorbed – making meaningful engagement less likely. {High Intent} Actively Searching Looking for answers and comparing options. Receptivity is high, but expectations are specific – relevance matters. {Selective Receptivity} Leaning Back Relaxed and less task-focused. Engagement is lighter, and interruptions are less welcome – messages must feel seamless to land. jsonld_parsed.name: GumGum
jsonld_parsed.description: GumGum is The Mindset Company™ — a global advertising technology company that identifies the moments consumers are most receptive to brand messages, delivering mindset-driven campaigns across CTV, online video, and high-impact display at scale.

contactPoint.name: Request a Demo
contactPoint.description: Connect with the GumGum team to discuss how mindset-driven advertising can work for your brand.

contactPoint.name: Publisher Partnerships
contactPoint.description: Apply to join GumGum's premium publisher network and unlock targeted demand for your inventory.

contactPoint.name: Media & Press
contactPoint.description: Press and media enquiries for GumGum.

additionalProperty.name: Proprietary AI Origin
additionalProperty.value: GumGum built its own contextual intelligence engine in 2010, analyzing content across text, image, and video — predating the AI advertising category by over a decade and forming the technological foundation of the Mindset Graph™.

additionalProperty.name: Brands Served
additionalProperty.value: 3,000+ brands worldwide

additionalProperty.name: Markets
additionalProperty.value: 19+ markets worldwide

additionalProperty.name: Job Functions
additionalProperty.value: Engineering, Sales, Client Solutions, Account Management, Marketing, Design, Operations, Data Science, Product Management

additionalProperty.name: Industry
additionalProperty.value: Advertising Technology (Adtech), Digital Media, Artificial Intelligence

additionalProperty.name: Employee Development Program
additionalProperty.value: GROW — GumGum's People Program focused on Growth, Recognition, Opportunity, and Winning. Provides tools, mentorship, and a culture of belonging for all employees.

additionalProperty.name: Culture Principles
additionalProperty.value: Customer Obsessed, Make It Happen, Always Innovate, Foster Belonging

additionalProperty.name: Employee Programs
additionalProperty.value: Women of GumGum, GumGum Gives Back, GumGum Fit, Virtual Leadership Bites, Life Skills Series, Coffee Walk

jsonld_parsed.name: GumGum | The Mindset Company™ — CTV & Contextual Advertising
jsonld_parsed.description: GumGum identifies the exact moment your audience is open to your message — delivering mindset-driven campaigns across CTV, contextual, and high-impact display at scale.

jsonld_parsed.name: Mindset Graph™
jsonld_parsed.description: The Mindset Graph™ is GumGum's AI-powered data engine, purpose-built to process the ever-expanding universe of historical, creative, contextual, and environmental data points in real time — determining the best combinations to drive outcomes for every campaign.

jsonld_parsed.name: GumGum Contextual
jsonld_parsed.description: AI-powered contextual advertising that analyzes content, imagery, and signals across the page to deliver privacy-forward, cookie-free targeting — without relying on audience data. GumGum reads the full content of every environment — text, images, video, and audio — across the open web and CTV, to identify brand-suitable, high-receptivity moments before every bid.

additionalProperty.name: Incremental Inventory vs Traditional Contextual
additionalProperty.value: Up to 473% more available inventory (MAGNA Global)

additionalProperty.name: Brand Favorability Lift Among Undecided Audiences
additionalProperty.value: +23 points vs +7 points from traditional contextual (MAGNA Global)

additionalProperty.name: Video Ad Memorability in Contextually Aligned Placements
additionalProperty.value: 2.3x more memorable

jsonld_parsed.name: CTV & Video Advertising
jsonld_parsed.description: CTV, connected TV, and online video advertising solutions that apply mindset intelligence to reach audiences at the moment they are most receptive — across premium streaming inventory and web and mobile video environments. Real-time signals including context, viewing environment, content sentiment, and engagement are evaluated before every bid.

additionalProperty.name: Channels
additionalProperty.value: Connected TV (CTV) and Online Video (OLV)

additionalProperty.name: Targeting Intelligence
additionalProperty.value: Mindset Graph™ — real-time evaluation of context, sentiment, relevance, and engagement before bid

additionalProperty.name: Streaming Platforms
additionalProperty.value: Roku, Peacock, Paramount+, Tubi, and connected streaming environments

jsonld_parsed.name: High-Impact Display Advertising
jsonld_parsed.description: High-impact display formats that combine premium creative, contextual intelligence, and mindset data to capture attention and drive stronger brand outcomes.

jsonld_parsed.name: GumGum Omnichannel Advertising
jsonld_parsed.description: GumGum's omnichannel advertising service activates CTV, online video, and high-impact display under unified mindset intelligence — reaching audiences in the right receptive moment across every screen.

additionalProperty.name: Agency Holding Company Partners
additionalProperty.value: Big 5

jsonld_parsed.name: GumGum Sports Media
jsonld_parsed.description: GumGum Sports Media turns verified sports viewership and on-screen sponsorship exposure into addressable audiences advertisers can activate across web, CTV, and online video. Powered by Relo Metrics sponsorship exposure data and VideoAmp deterministic viewership data, it offers three targeting products: Replay, Counterplay, and GumGum Sports Audiences.

additionalProperty.name: Targeting Products
additionalProperty.value: Replay, Counterplay, and GumGum Sports Audiences

additionalProperty.name: Leagues Covered for Sponsorship Exposure
additionalProperty.value: NFL, NBA, WNBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, NWSL, Formula 1, and NCAA Football

additionalProperty.name: Activation Channels
additionalProperty.value: Web, Connected TV (CTV), and Online Video (OLV)

additionalProperty.name: Sponsorship Exposure Data
additionalProperty.value: Relo Metrics — on-screen sponsorship detection with broadcast timestamps

additionalProperty.name: Viewership Data
additionalProperty.value: VideoAmp — deterministic, ACR-based household viewership

additionalProperty.name: Campaign Availability
additionalProperty.value: United States

jsonld_parsed.name: Replay
jsonld_parsed.description: Replay is sponsorship activation in sports. GumGum matches Relo Metrics' record of when a brand's sponsorship appeared on screen against VideoAmp's verified viewership data, building an audience of the households that were watching when the placement aired, then re-engaging them across web, CTV, and online video.

additionalProperty.name: Requirement
additionalProperty.value: Brand must hold a sponsorship in a league covered by Relo Census

jsonld_parsed.name: Counterplay
jsonld_parsed.description: Counterplay is conquesting advertising for live sports. GumGum identifies the households verified to have been watching when a competitor's sponsorship appeared on screen and turns them into an addressable audience a brand can reach across web, CTV, and online video.

additionalProperty.name: Requirement
additionalProperty.value: Competitor must hold a sponsorship in a league covered by Relo Census

jsonld_parsed.name: GumGum Sports Audiences
jsonld_parsed.description: GumGum Sports Audiences reaches verified fans of specific sports and leagues using VideoAmp's deterministic viewership data, with no sponsorship required. Audiences are built from what households actually watched rather than modeled interests, and activated across display, online video, and CTV.

additionalProperty.name: Requirement
additionalProperty.value: No sponsorship required

Stay tuned for more updates.</h5><p>In today's rapidly evolving digital landscape, cookieless marketing is quickly becoming the name of the game. As privacy concerns heighten and regulatory bodies reinforce data protection norms, traditional cookie-based targeting is less reliable, less effective and more restricted.</p><p>In fact, cookieless solutions are offering marketers a huge opportunity for growth. Adopting cookieless solutions is not only more privacy forward, but it is also the primary means for brands and advertisers to build transparent and trustworthy relationships with consumers - ones that are built to last.</p><p>In this blog post, we will discuss why marketers should embrace cookieless solutions as part of their advertising strategies. We will discuss the current state of cookieless marketing, plus new alternatives, including contextual advertising, and what marketers can do to build up their cookieless marketing plans.</p><h2>The Current State of Cookieless Solutions</h2><p>Google dropped some big news recently—they're phasing out third-party cookies by 2025. That's a game-changer for advertising because those cookies have been the backbone of how advertisers track users across websites. Without them, marketers can't rely on the same level of detailed targeting and personalized ads. </p><p>Instead, Google's pushing for more privacy-friendly approaches like using first-party data, data clean rooms, alternative identity solutions and the Privacy Sandbox. It's all about respecting user privacy more, which is great, but it means advertisers will have to get creative with how they reach their audiences.</p><p>It's a shift that's shaking up the whole digital advertising playbook, forcing everyone to rethink strategies and find new ways to connect with consumers without compromising their privacy.</p><figure style="max-width:1200pxpx" class="w-richtext-align-fullwidth w-richtext-figure-type-image"><div><img alt="The Third Party Cookie Deprecation Timeline & Its Effect on Advertising Strategies " src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69f4d97fb6cc554acaf4ca76/6a1e12b34766c5e7675b2430_667980c5a520ab5eb4378ec8_Cookieless_02_Timeline.png" loading="lazy"/></div></figure><p>{{cta-1}}</p><h3>Are marketers ready to embrace cookieless solutions?</h3><p>The cookieless era is fast approaching! Here's how marketers are feeling about it:</p><figure style="max-width:1200pxpx" class="w-richtext-align-fullwidth w-richtext-figure-type-image"><div><img alt="How Marketers and Publishers Feel About Letting Go of Third Party Data & Aggregated Data of Consumers" src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69f4d97fb6cc554acaf4ca76/6a1e12b34766c5e7675b2421_667983f939f819810099c228_Cookieless_03_Stats.png" loading="lazy"/></div></figure><h2>Why You Should Embrace Cookieless Solutions</h2><figure style="max-width:1200pxpx" class="w-richtext-align-fullwidth w-richtext-figure-type-image"><div><img alt="Types of Solutions Without Third Party Data (Including Alt. Identity Solutions, Data Clean Rooms, Zero Party Data, etc.) and Their Benefits for the Customer Journey" src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69f4d97fb6cc554acaf4ca76/6a1e12b34766c5e7675b2424_6679841f15986b92b83e85b6_Cookieless_04_Solutions.png" loading="lazy"/></div></figure><h3><strong>1. Helps You Reach Users in the Right Frame of Mind</strong></h3><p>When a person is browsing content about a specific topic, it signals their intent at that moment. For example, if a user is reading a blog about coffee, they are in a receptive frame of mind when it comes to content and ads related to coffee. </p><p>With cookieless targeting, that user could be served ads for coffee beans or coffee makers, as it’s likely at that time the user is thinking about coffee-related products. A person’s content consumption signals intent at a specific moment in time, and with cookieless targeting, you can reach them in that moment. </p><h3><strong>2. Helps You Target Niche Audiences</strong></h3><p>Contextual advertising also provides the opportunity for marketers to target niche contexts by specifying a topic or a collection of keywords. For example, a marketer who is running a campaign for a mascara product may want to create value alignment between users and the mascara by highlighting that the mascara is vegan. </p><p>Cookieless targeting would enable them to indicate keywords related to vegan makeup to precisely target a niche customer profile. This strategy is effective because it ensures your ads are served to consumers who are receptive to the niche attributes of a product or service. </p><h3><strong><code>3. Provides Real-Ti</code>me Metrics</strong></h3><p>Since contextual advertising campaigns are served programmatically, you can review <a href="https://supermetrics.com/podcasts/contextual-advertising-ned-dmitrov" target="_blank" data-wf-native-id-path="cf5b04d5-d2c5-65c4-6db9-e7fb7e695484:c870cb8d-407a-79ef-d23a-5487922819c9" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="c870cb8d-407a-79ef-d23a-5487922819c9" data-wf-component-context="%5B%7B%22componentId%22%3A%22c0220f9f-f983-d551-b7db-df95ab3aec9d%22%2C%22instanceId%22%3A%22cf5b04d5-d2c5-65c4-6db9-e7fb7e695484%22%7D%5D"><strong>real-time metrics</strong></a> and optimize for maximum performance. With the right programmatic platform, you can verify your ads served on relevant domains pre- and in-flight. This gives you the ability to revise your selected topics and keywords in real-time to <a href="https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/cookieless-targeting-drive-performance" data-wf-native-id-path="cf5b04d5-d2c5-65c4-6db9-e7fb7e695484:ea2b44b5-0e33-d2d1-c0d8-976a1718ee35" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="ea2b44b5-0e33-d2d1-c0d8-976a1718ee35" data-wf-component-context="%5B%7B%22componentId%22%3A%22c0220f9f-f983-d551-b7db-df95ab3aec9d%22%2C%22instanceId%22%3A%22cf5b04d5-d2c5-65c4-6db9-e7fb7e695484%22%7D%5D"><strong>improve the performance of your campaigns</strong></a>.</p><p>Optimizing your campaigns in real-time strengthens your live campaign’s performance which ultimately improves the outcome. And, being able to make in-flight changes means you’re able to make adjustments that will reduce any ad dollar waste. </p><h3><strong>4. Promotes Brand Safety and Builds Brand Affinity</strong></h3><p>Now more than ever, consumers care about where they shop, and they are increasingly conscious of the environments where brands choose to advertise. Contextual advertising addresses the need for brand safe advertising while also <a href="https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/brand-affinity" data-wf-native-id-path="cf5b04d5-d2c5-65c4-6db9-e7fb7e695484:cc96a055-4391-2330-731a-bb75d43a4ff2" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="cc96a055-4391-2330-731a-bb75d43a4ff2" data-wf-component-context="%5B%7B%22componentId%22%3A%22c0220f9f-f983-d551-b7db-df95ab3aec9d%22%2C%22instanceId%22%3A%22cf5b04d5-d2c5-65c4-6db9-e7fb7e695484%22%7D%5D"><strong>building brand affinity</strong></a>, leveraging content rather than user data to reach the right audience. You’re able to connect with consumers who are receptive to purpose-driven messaging and are looking specifically for brands that align with certain values. </p><p>For example, a consumer who is interested in reducing their environmental impact will likely browse online for content that provides insights on sustainable living. With contextual targeting, a brand that is promoting their zero-waste products can target the key phrase “sustainable lifestyle” to appear next to content that covers related topics. This strategy ensures that the brand is reaching consumers who will align with the brand’s values. </p><h2>Understanding the Types of Cookieless Solutions</h2><p>Cookieless targeting uses first party data, anonymized data points and AI and machine learning to target ads to users without compromising their privacy or violating regulations like the General Data Protection Regulation (<a href="https://gdpr-info.eu/" target="_blank" data-wf-native-id-path="cf5b04d5-d2c5-65c4-6db9-e7fb7e695484:3428d017-1565-d841-a271-f31baef98474" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="3428d017-1565-d841-a271-f31baef98474" data-wf-component-context="%5B%7B%22componentId%22%3A%22c0220f9f-f983-d551-b7db-df95ab3aec9d%22%2C%22instanceId%22%3A%22cf5b04d5-d2c5-65c4-6db9-e7fb7e695484%22%7D%5D"><strong>GDPR</strong></a>) or the California Consumer Privacy Act (<a href="https://oag.ca.gov/privacy/ccpa" target="_blank" data-wf-native-id-path="cf5b04d5-d2c5-65c4-6db9-e7fb7e695484:a188151a-ef4c-2923-f06b-9ef481e32124" data-wf-ao-click-engagement-tracking="true" data-wf-element-id="a188151a-ef4c-2923-f06b-9ef481e32124" data-wf-component-context="%5B%7B%22componentId%22%3A%22c0220f9f-f983-d551-b7db-df95ab3aec9d%22%2C%22instanceId%22%3A%22cf5b04d5-d2c5-65c4-6db9-e7fb7e695484%22%7D%5D"><strong>CCPA</strong></a>).</p><p>When it comes to cookieless advertising, there are three main methods most digital marketing teams use:</p><h3><strong>Authenticated Targeting:</strong></h3><p>Authenticated targeting is when an advertiser gains explicit consent from a user—often through a pop-up, login screen, or sign-up form—to use their data for advertising purposes.</p><h3><strong>Anonymous Targeting:</strong></h3><p><strong>Anonymous targeting </strong>doesn’t use personal identifiers, like names or email addresses, and instead relies on alternative methods to segment and target specific audiences anonymously.</p><h3><strong>Contextual Targeting</strong>:</h3><p>Contextual targeting uses AI and machine learning to deliver ads based on the context of the webpage the user is viewing, with advertisers using keywords, topics, or categories to target their ads.</p><h2>Why Contextual Targeting is a Vital Cookieless Solution</h2><p>Contextual targeting is like hitting the bullseye without needing a GPS. It the only cookieless solution that focuses on understanding and targeting the mindset of what audiences are doing now whereas others still attempt to build user profiles and target audiences on what they did before - much like cookies!</p><p>Contextual targeting relies on the content of web pages rather than user data. By analyzing the context in which ads are displayed, such as the themes, topics, and keywords of a webpage, advertisers can effectively reach relevant audiences without relying on invasive tracking mechanisms. This approach not only respects user privacy but also ensures a more accurate alignment between ad content and user interests based on the content they are actively engaged with.</p><p>Moreover, contextual targeting offers resilience against regulatory changes and evolving privacy concerns by providing a sustainable advertising method that prioritizes user trust and data protection. As such, it stands as a vital tool for marketers looking to maintain effective ad campaigns in a privacy-conscious digital landscape.</p><h2>3 Steps to Get Ready for a Cookieless Future</h2><figure style="max-width:1200pxpx" class="w-richtext-align-fullwidth w-richtext-figure-type-image"><div><img alt="Illustration of 3 Steps to Get Ready for a Cookieless Future" src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69f4d97fb6cc554acaf4ca76/6a1e12b34766c5e7675b2427_66798855f7a48557f04af360_Cookieless_05_Steps.png" loading="lazy"/></div></figure><h3><strong>1. Prioritize Contextual Targeting</strong></h3><p>Advertisers and marketers clearly understand the need for contextual advertising. But there’s a gap between acknowledging the need for it and adding it to their repertoire.</p><p>The widespread adoption of cookieless advertising solutions like contextual advertising is coming. Marketers should prioritize the implementation of contextual targeting tactics to ensure they don’t get left behind. </p><h3><strong>2. Educate Yourself About Cookieless Advertising</strong></h3><p>Digital marketing requires creative thinking and staying on top of the latest trends, technology, and channels. The best way to get ahead of industry changes is to invest time in learning and development. </p><p>Educating yourself and your media buyers on how to be successful in a cookieless environment could be the difference between continued campaign success and a dip in performance. </p><h3><strong>3. Find the Right Programmatic Partner</strong></h3><p>Programmatic platforms that provide cookieless advertising, especially those that leverage machine learning and AI, are the best resources in times of uncertainty. They’re experts in the field, and know the best ways to learn and ramp up. </p><p>Your partner should understand the nuances of the industry and how to foster success in the post-cookie landscape. You’ll want them to have expertise in all areas of digital advertising, including which channels, data providers, and ad formats to leverage and prioritize.</p><h2>GumGum’s Cookieless Solution</h2><p>We’ve been running successful future-proof cookieless solutions since 2009. As pioneers of contextual targeting, we capture and measure your audience’s attention by effectively placing your ads when they are in the right mindset.</p><figure style="max-width:1200pxpx" class="w-richtext-align-fullwidth w-richtext-figure-type-image"><div><img alt="GumGum's Cookieless Solution to Protect Consumer Privacy, Protect Customer Data and Drive ROI" src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69f4d97fb6cc554acaf4ca76/6a1e12b34766c5e7675b242a_667988e40654e4eadb745a84_Cookieless_07_GGSolution.png" loading="lazy"/></div></figure><p>This level of insight allows your brand to identify insights and trends, determine suitability and brand safety, expand your reach and future-proof your targeting.</p><h3><strong>We Set the Industry Standard in Cookieless Contextual Targeting</strong></h3><p>GumGum’s advanced contextual technology, Verity™, works by using AI to go beyond keywords and uniquely process web content signals across Text, Image, Audio, and Video - all without cookies.</p><p>Verity™ is the first advanced contextual platform to receive MRC’s content-level accreditation for contextual analysis, brand safety and suitability across CTV, desktop, and mobile web.</p><figure style="max-width:1200pxpx" class="w-richtext-align-fullwidth w-richtext-figure-type-image"><div><img alt="How GumGum's Contextual Targeting Works to Reach Consumers " src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69f4d97fb6cc554acaf4ca76/6a1e12b34766c5e7675b2442_66798998cbb8b6280d123da2_Cookieless_06_Standard.png" loading="lazy"/></div></figure><p>Verity™ identifies a full suite of contextual signals, allowing both the buy-side and the sell-side to truly define and implement brand safety and suitability.</p><p>In a Dentsu Aegis Network study, Verity™ was 1.7x more accurate than other contextual vendors. Verity™ also achieved a 48% lower cost per click and a 41% lower cost per viewable impression than behavioral targeting.</p><p>Verity™'s cookieless solution is giving brands a massive opportunity for UPDATE: As of July 22, 2024, Google is abandoning its plans to deprecate third-party cookies from Chrome. Stay tuned for more updates. In today's rapidly evolving digital landscape, cookieless marketing is quickly becoming the name of the game. As privacy concerns heighten and regulatory bodies reinforce data protection norms, traditional cookie-based targeting is less reliable, less effective and more restricted. In fact, cookieless solutions are offering marketers a huge opportunity for growth. Adopting cookieless solutions is not only more privacy forward, but it is also the primary means for brands and advertisers to build transparent and trustworthy relationships with consumers - ones that are built to last. In this blog post, we will discuss why marketers should embrace cookieless solutions as part of their advertising strategies. We will discuss the current state of cookieless marketing, plus new alternatives, including contextual advertising, and what marketers can do to build up their cookieless marketing plans. The Current State of Cookieless Solutions Google dropped some big news recently—they're phasing out third-party cookies by 2025. That's a game-changer for advertising because those cookies have been the backbone of how advertisers track users across websites. Without them, marketers can't rely on the same level of detailed targeting and personalized ads. Instead, Google's pushing for more privacy-friendly approaches like using first-party data, data clean rooms, alternative identity solutions and the Privacy Sandbox. It's all about respecting user privacy more, which is great, but it means advertisers will have to get creative with how they reach their audiences. It's a shift that's shaking up the whole digital advertising playbook, forcing everyone to rethink strategies and find new ways to connect with consumers without compromising their privacy. {{cta-1}} Are marketers ready to embrace cookieless solutions? The cookieless era is fast approaching! Here's how marketers are feeling about it: Why You Should Embrace Cookieless Solutions 1. Helps You Reach Users in the Right Frame of Mind When a person is browsing content about a specific topic, it signals their intent at that moment. For example, if a user is reading a blog about coffee, they are in a receptive frame of mind when it comes to content and ads related to coffee. With cookieless targeting, that user could be served ads for coffee beans or coffee makers, as it’s likely at that time the user is thinking about coffee-related products. A person’s content consumption signals intent at a specific moment in time, and with cookieless targeting, you can reach them in that moment. 2. Helps You Target Niche Audiences Contextual advertising also provides the opportunity for marketers to target niche contexts by specifying a topic or a collection of keywords. For example, a marketer who is running a campaign for a mascara product may want to create value alignment between users and the mascara by highlighting that the mascara is vegan. Cookieless targeting would enable them to indicate keywords related to vegan makeup to precisely target a niche customer profile. This strategy is effective because it ensures your ads are served to consumers who are receptive to the niche attributes of a product or service. 3. Provides Real-Ti me Metrics Since contextual advertising campaigns are served programmatically, you can review real-time metrics and optimize for maximum performance. With the right programmatic platform, you can verify your ads served on relevant domains pre- and in-flight. This gives you the ability to revise your selected topics and keywords in real-time to improve the performance of your campaigns . Optimizing your campaigns in real-time strengthens your live campaign’s performance which ultimately improves the outcome. And, being able to make in-flight changes means you’re able to make adjustments that will reduce any ad dollar waste. 4. Promotes Brand Safety and Builds Brand Affinity Now more than ever, consumers care about where they shop, and they are increasingly conscious of the environments where brands choose to advertise. Contextual advertising addresses the need for brand safe advertising while also building brand affinity , leveraging content rather than user data to reach the right audience. You’re able to connect with consumers who are receptive to purpose-driven messaging and are looking specifically for brands that align with certain values. For example, a consumer who is interested in reducing their environmental impact will likely browse online for content that provides insights on sustainable living. With contextual targeting, a brand that is promoting their zero-waste products can target the key phrase “sustainable lifestyle” to appear next to content that covers related topics. This strategy ensures that the brand is reaching consumers who will align with the brand’s values. Understanding the Types of Cookieless Solutions Cookieless targeting uses first party data, anonymized data points and AI and machine learning to target ads to users without compromising their privacy or violating regulations like the General Data Protection Regulation ( GDPR ) or the California Consumer Privacy Act ( CCPA ). When it comes to cookieless advertising, there are three main methods most digital marketing teams use: Authenticated Targeting: Authenticated targeting is when an advertiser gains explicit consent from a user—often through a pop-up, login screen, or sign-up form—to use their data for advertising purposes. Anonymous Targeting: Anonymous targeting doesn’t use personal identifiers, like names or email addresses, and instead relies on alternative methods to segment and target specific audiences anonymously. Contextual Targeting : Contextual targeting uses AI and machine learning to deliver ads based on the context of the webpage the user is viewing, with advertisers using keywords, topics, or categories to target their ads. Why Contextual Targeting is a Vital Cookieless Solution Contextual targeting is like hitting the bullseye without needing a GPS. It the only cookieless solution that focuses on understanding and targeting the mindset of what audiences are doing now whereas others still attempt to build user profiles and target audiences on what they did before - much like cookies! Contextual targeting relies on the content of web pages rather than user data. By analyzing the context in which ads are displayed, such as the themes, topics, and keywords of a webpage, advertisers can effectively reach relevant audiences without relying on invasive tracking mechanisms. This approach not only respects user privacy but also ensures a more accurate alignment between ad content and user interests based on the content they are actively engaged with. Moreover, contextual targeting offers resilience against regulatory changes and evolving privacy concerns by providing a sustainable advertising method that prioritizes user trust and data protection. As such, it stands as a vital tool for marketers looking to maintain effective ad campaigns in a privacy-conscious digital landscape. 3 Steps to Get Ready for a Cookieless Future 1. Prioritize Contextual Targeting Advertisers and marketers clearly understand the need for contextual advertising. But there’s a gap between acknowledging the need for it and adding it to their repertoire. The widespread adoption of cookieless advertising solutions like contextual advertising is coming. Marketers should prioritize the implementation of contextual targeting tactics to ensure they don’t get left behind. 2. Educate Yourself About Cookieless Advertising Digital marketing requires creative thinking and staying on top of the latest trends, technology, and channels. The best way to get ahead of industry changes is to invest time in learning and development. Educating yourself and your media buyers on how to be successful in a cookieless environment could be the difference between continued campaign success and a dip in performance. 3. Find the Right Programmatic Partner Programmatic platforms that provide cookieless advertising, especially those that leverage machine learning and AI, are the best resources in times of uncertainty. They’re experts in the field, and know the best ways to learn and ramp up. Your partner should understand the nuances of the industry and how to foster success in the post-cookie landscape. You’ll want them to have expertise in all areas of digital advertising, including which channels, data providers, and ad formats to leverage and prioritize. GumGum’s Cookieless Solution We’ve been running successful future-proof cookieless solutions since 2009. As pioneers of contextual targeting, we capture and measure your audience’s attention by effectively placing your ads when they are in the right mindset. This level of insight allows your brand to identify insights and trends, determine suitability and brand safety, expand your reach and future-proof your targeting. We Set the Industry Standard in Cookieless Contextual Targeting GumGum’s advanced contextual technology, Verity™, works by using AI to go beyond keywords and uniquely process web content signals across Text, Image, Audio, and Video - all without cookies. Verity™ is the first advanced contextual platform to receive MRC’s content-level accreditation for contextual analysis, brand safety and suitability across CTV, desktop, and mobile web. Verity™ identifies a full suite of contextual signals, allowing both the buy-side and the sell-side to truly define and implement brand safety and suitability. In a Dentsu Aegis Network study, Verity™ was 1.7x more accurate than other contextual vendors. Verity™ also achieved a 48% lower cost per click and a 41% lower cost per viewable impression than behavioral targeting. Marcus is focused on continuing the company’s mission to empower advertisers to achieve better outcomes through understanding consumer mindsets.</p><p>Marcus is a three-time CEO with a successful background in scaling companies to $1B+ revenue. An active member of the ad tech community, he holds an IAB Tech Lab board seat, is a member of the OpenRTB Working Group, and leads the LA AdTech Meetup for regional tech engineers and product managers. Weiner is also a frequent conference speaker and guest columnist for VentureBeat and Forbes. In 2015, he was named LA Business Journal’s CTO of the Year, and, in 2003, he was included in the InfoWorld 100 for his work on uPortal, an open-source web portal framework for the higher education community.</p><p>Before coming to GumGum, Weiner was the Director of Engineering at the lead-generation platform LowerMyBills.com, acquired by Experian in 2005. He has also worked as an open-source software consultant, a project manager and an instructor at Interactive Business Solutions, acquired by Unicon Inc. in 2003. Weiner received a B.S. from UCLA and currently lives in Los Angeles. Away from the office, he enjoys mountain biking, hiking, California native plants, jazz music and playing the saxophone.</p></div></div></div></div></div></dialog><div class="component-js w-embed w-script"><script>

class="team-card-modal_right_text text-rich-text text-size-m w-richtext"><p>Adam Schenkel is the Chief Operating Officer (COO) of GumGum, where he oversees the company’s global operations and is responsible for driving organizational excellence, operational scalability, and cross-functional alignment in partnership with the CEO and executive leadership team. In his role, Adam leads Media Operations; DSP partnerships; Publisher Development; Creative Design; Ad Operations; Account Management; global strategic initiatives; and GumGum’s approach to Open Market trading and Supply Path Optimization. As COO, he also helps shape and execute company strategy, guiding operational frameworks that support GumGum’s long-term growth.</p><p>Previously, Adam served as EVP, Global Platform Strategy and Operations, where he led key pillars of GumGum’s platform evolution and marketplace strategy. Before that, as Senior Vice President of Global Commercial Development, he oversaw programmatic advertising, international markets, and business development. During this time, Adam also drove GumGum’s successful effort to secure MRC accreditation for both Brand Safety and Contextual Targeting, cementing the company’s leadership in contextual intelligence.</p><p>Since joining GumGum in 2013, Adam has been instrumental in shaping the company’s programmatic capabilities, founding its Programmatic Department and launching the industry’s first custom in-image programmatic offering to be transacted at scale in real time. He has also been an active contributor to industry standards as a member of the IAB Programmatic Council since 2014.</p><p>Prior to GumGum, Adam worked in reality television as well as celebrity licensing and endorsement at United Talent Agency. He holds a degree from Arizona State University’s W. P. Carey School of Business and currently resides in Calabasas, California. An avid sports fan, Adam enjoys playing golf and traveling when he is not working.</p></div></div></div></div></div></dialog><div class="component-js w-embed w-script"><script>

class="team-card-modal_right_text text-rich-text text-size-m w-richtext"><p>Patrick Gildea is the Chief Financial Officer for GumGum, leading the finance, accounting and legal departments. Patrick’s hands-on leadership style has allowed him to build high-performing teams to support scalable operations aligned with the vision of the business. Over the past decade, Patrick has led finance, HR, legal, strategy, corporate and business development departments that span from the start-up phase to high-growth global public companies with multiple successful strategic exits.</p><p>Prior to GumGum, Patrick help lead Joybird.com to a successful exit with La-Z-boy, served as the CFO of Gracenote, where he was instrumental in both its growth to a $250 million business that operated 5 divisions with more than 2,000 employees in 20 offices around the globe and in its sale to Nielsen Media in 2017. Patrick also served as the first CFO of M-GO, scaling the business and ultimately selling it to NBCUniversal to become FandangoNow.com.</p><p>Earlier in his career, Patrick was the Group Vice President of Corporate Strategy and Development at Blackhawk Network (NASDAQ:HAWK), ran corporate development at IC Media, where he helped raise three rounds of venture capital and sold the business to Citibank Private Equity. Patrick began his career as a CPA at Arthur Andersen, after graduating with a degree in Japanese from Sophia University and a B.S. in Accounting from the University of Southern California.</p></div></div></div></div></div></dialog><div class="component-js w-embed w-script"><script>

class="team-card-modal_right_text text-rich-text text-size-m w-richtext"><p>As Head of People Operations, Kelly Battelle is responsible for hiring, developing and engaging the industry’s best talent and for creating a positive, collaborative work environment where GumGum’s thinkers and doers can thrive. With more than 20 years of human resources experience, Battelle is a highly skilled communicator who takes pride in her ability to develop cross-departmental strategies that push our business forward and keep our team members engaged and thriving.</p><p>Battelle comes to GumGum from media giant The Walt Disney Company, where she served in the capacity of HR Business Partner. Throughout her career, she has served in a variety of other HR management and leadership capacities at a variety of small- and mid-sized technology and digital companies, including Razorfish and RealNetworks. She is an advisor on the People Tech Partners LA Chapter and holds a BA in Sociology from Washington State University and a Certificate in Coaching from The Coach Institute. When she’s not making GumGum a great place to work, she enjoys spending time at her family cabin in Big Bear with her husband, Tony, her daughters, Emily and Elise, and her kitty, Riley.</p></div></div></div></div></div></dialog><div class="component-js w-embed w-script"><script>

class="team-card-modal_right_text text-rich-text text-size-m w-richtext"><p>Laura Foster is SVP of Global Marketing at GumGum, where she leads the team responsible for telling the story of mindset-based advertising to the world. Her job: make sure GumGum’s message is as sharp on the outside as the thinking is on the inside.</p><p>Before GumGum, Laura spent nearly a decade at Innovid, rising to VP of Product Marketing and leading the team through multiple acquisitions, a successful IPO, and some of the most consequential shifts in the TV advertising landscape. Earlier in her career, she held sales and strategic roles at Sizmek, building her foundation in ad tech up and down the West Coast.</p><p>Laura has been recognized as a Business Insider Rising Star of Adtech, a Chief Marketer Top Women in Marketing “One to Watch,” a member of LA TV Week’s 40 Under 40, and a Product Marketing Alliance Top 100 Influencer. class="team-card-modal_right_text text-rich-text text-size-m w-richtext"><p>Hailey Denenberg is SVP of Strategy & Business Operations at GumGum, where she leads global strategy, go-to-market execution, and business operations across the company’s media and data portfolio. During her tenure, she has helped shape GumGum’s strategic direction and differentiation through its unique Mindset approach, incubated and scaled new revenue streams—including launching the company’s contextual data business, and driven operational excellence across regions.</p><p>Prior to GumGum, Hailey was a Management Consultant at Deloitte, where she advised leading media and technology companies on ad tech strategy, operating model transformation, digital video go-to-market strategy, and large-scale modernization initiatives.</p><p>She holds an MBA from Columbia Business School and a B.A. from UCLA. She lives in coastal Los Angeles and outside of the office is an avid tennis player, hiker, and pastry chef.</p></div></div></div></div></div></dialog><div class="component-js w-embed w-script"><script>

entertainment industries at companies ranging from start-ups to global, publicly traded entities. His experience includes mergers and acquisitions, divestitures, capital raising and an initial public offering.</p><p>Rasmus is an inactive CPA and began his career in public accounting at KPMG in South Africa after graduating with a degree in Accounting from the University of Pretoria and an Honors degree in Accounting from the University of South Africa.</p></div></div></div></div></div></dialog><div class="component-js w-embed w-script"><script>

We call that mindset. GumGum has spent over 15 years building the technology to make that possible at scale. Our Vision Transform Advertising Through Mindset An industry built around audience data has optimized for reach. We're building toward something different. A future where receptivity is the standard, and every impression is placed in a moment of genuine openness.
